complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_1: Complain to telecom operator first; obtain ticket/reference number.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_2: If unresolved within operator timeline, escalate to NCC (622 + email channels). Attach ticket + evidence.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_3: If fraud/crime involved (SIM swap fraud, extortion, trafficking), report to NPF and copy NCC + PCC + NHRC as applicable.

security_rules.note: Server uses Redis durability where available. In-memory resets on restart. TTL ensures auto expiry.
